title: Holoholo Charters
specs: For safety, no pregnant women or children under 5 are allowed.
If I can’t swim will I be able to snorkel?
Will we need swim suits/wet suits?
We recommend that you wear a swim suits for our snorkel tours (bring a towel and dry clothes to change into after snorkeling).
Do I really need my photo ID?
We require all passengers that will be partaking in alcohol to have a photo ID.
We are not able to serve passengers alcohol if they are not able to show a photo ID upon request.

services.name: Nāpali Sunset Dinner Sail
services.desc: Experience a 4.5-hour Nāpali Coast evening aboard Leila, our 50-foot motorized sailing catamaran.

services.name: Nāpali Sunset Dinner Cruise
services.desc: Experience a 3.5-hour Napali Coast evening aboard Holoholo, our spacious 65-foot power catamaran.

services.name: The Nāpali Coast Snorkel Excursion
services.desc: Experience the Nāpali Coast from the water aboard Leila, with towering sea cliffs, marine life, and one captain-selected swim and snorkel stop.

services.name: The Niʻihau & Nāpali Snorkel Expedition
services.desc: Set out on Kauaʻi’s only daily boat tour to Niʻihau, combining Nāpali sightseeing with remote offshore snorkeling aboard Holoholo.

includes: We provide all the snorkel gear—including floatation—and professional instruction to make sure you have a great time in the water.

faq.q: What does it mean to be barefoot?
faq.a: The deck has a non-slip surface best fitted for bare feet. Flip flops, shoes, water shoes etc. can grip too much or not enough.
